dishes.name: Ayvalık tostu
dishes.desc: A large toasted sandwich of sucuk, salami, sausage, kaşar, tomato and pickles on crisp bread, pressed hard. Registered as a traditional product in 2023.

dishes.name: Ada köftesi
dishes.desc: Thyme-scented veal meatballs that came with the Cretan exchange. Cunda and Ayvalık kitchens still serve them.

dishes.name: Gardumi
dishes.desc: Milk-fed lamb intestine stuffed and cooked, counted among Ayvalık's oldest dishes.

dishes.name: Ayvalık lor tatlısı
dishes.desc: A curd-cheese dessert specific to Ayvalık. On Cunda it is served with sour cherry jam.

dishes.name: Kalburabastı
dishes.desc: A syrup-soaked sweet pastry that Ayvalık is known for, served with an ash-scented syrup.
